user.title: TechniSat Receiver HA
user.description: Receivers found on your network. Choose "—" to enter an IP address manually.

manual.title: Receiver IP address
manual.description: Discovery found nothing (or is blocked, e.g. Docker bridge network). Enter the IP address of the receiver.

pin.title: PIN
pin.description: PIN of {name} ({host}) as set under Settings → Network → App control (default 0000).

error.cannot_connect: The receiver does not answer. Check the IP address, and that Quick Start is enabled.
error.unsupported_device: This device type is not supported (only set-top boxes were tested).
error.rcu_disabled: No answer to the PIN. Enable "App control" in the receiver's network settings.
error.wrong_device: This is a different receiver than the one configured.

init.title: Power state source
init.description: The receiver cannot report whether it is on or in standby, so the state is assumed. Optionally pick an entity that does know, e.g. the power sensor of a smart plug. Sensors count as on above the threshold; other entities when their state is on.

unknown_command.message: Unknown command "{command}". Use a key name from the README or a code from 0 to 127.

auth_failed.message: The receiver at {host} did not accept the PIN or has app control disabled.
